subject: math
cluster: Know number names and the count sequence

items.prompt: Count by ones starting at $1$. What number comes right after $8$?

steps: Counting by ones means each number is one more than the last.

items.prompt: When counting by tens, what comes after $20$?

steps: Counting by tens goes $10, 20, 30, \dots$, adding ten each time.

items.prompt: What number comes right before $10$ when counting by ones?

steps: Counting by ones, the number before $10$ is one less.

items.prompt: Count by ones. What number comes after $49$?
Count by tens: $10, 20, 30, 40, \dots$ What comes next?
What number comes after $99$ when counting to $100$?

steps: One more than $99$ is the last number you count to.
